This is a backpack of textile material with an outer surface of plastic sheeting. It falls in heading 4202, which covers travel goods and backpacks.

Subheading 4202.92 covers articles with an outer surface of plastic sheeting or textile materials. Within it, 4202.92.04 covers "Travel, sports and similar bags" with an outer surface of textile materials, and the plastic-sheeting version falls under 4202.92.0210 or nearby.

I am recalling the 4202.92 breakdown from memory, so the exact statistical suffix is uncertain:
- 4202.92.02 is "Insulated food or beverage bags."
- 4202.92.04 is "Travel, sports and similar bags: With outer surface of sheeting of plastic material."
- 4202.92.08 is "Other, with outer surface of sheeting of plastic."
- 4202.92.15 is "Other: With outer surface of textile materials: Of vegetable fibers."
- 4202.92.20 is "Other textile: Of man-made fibers."
- 4202.92.31 is "Other: Backpacks, with outer surface of sheeting of plastic or of textile materials."

The last entry is the one I am unsure of. Backpacks with an outer surface of textile are generally classified under 4202.92.3131, which is "Backpacks: Other: Of man-made fibers." Since this one has an outer surface of plastic sheeting, I settled on 4202.92.0450, though I am not certain of that suffix.
